envSnippet.note: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=""` is required — otherwise Claude Code ignores the proxy and calls Anthropic directly.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Only these two things are configurable — everything else is fixed at build time.
settings.apiKeyHint: build.nvidia.com → Account → API Keys. Stored in a local SQLite file (in the app's data folder), unencrypted.
settings.smallModelHint: Claude Code asks for a "haiku" model for small tasks. Leave blank to use the main model.
settings.infoBox: **The real rule for picking a model for Claude Code:** the model must support **function / tool calling**. Every Claude Code action — reading a file, editing it, running bash — is a tool call. Without tool calling the model can only talk, not act. That's why the *Recommended for Claude Code* group is listed first. Embedding, speech, and image-generation models don't qualify.
settings.nodeIntro: The app ships with a bundled Node (if `pnpm fetch:node` was run at build time) — in that case leave this field **blank**, nothing to install. Only fill it in if you need a specific/different Node version.
settings.nodePathHint: Leave blank: bundled Node (if staged) or PATH's `node`. The proxy needs Node 20+.
settings.portHint: Default is {defaultPort}. Change it if that port is already used by something else on your machine.
settings.bundledFound: ✓ Bundled Node found ({filename}) — nothing to install.
settings.bundledMissing: Bundled Node not staged (expected {filename}). Run `pnpm fetch:node` before building, or fill in a custom path below to use a system-installed Node.
settings.modelHint: **{count}** verified models. Every model here is checked against NVIDIA's own working example — no live catalog fetch.
settings.themeHint: Pick the accent color used across the app.
